2 Bedroom Apartment in Amanzimtoti

32 riverview court, 11 farewell road
2 1 1 2 867 m² 80 m²

SPACIOUS 80 SQUARE METRE - 2 BEDROOM APARTMENT - ENCLOSED BALCONY - R775 000

While some people must get used to living in a flat, you will immediately feel at home here because of the exquisite, lovely, warm-coloured tiles throughout and the beautifully golden wooden kitchen. As you enter throughout the door you come into this really gorgeous kitchen that has everything for your culinary requirements with lots of cupboard space for all your utensils. From the kitchen you enter a very big spacious lounge. At the end of it are sliding doors leading to an enclosed balcony that could serve as another small room. The view from this balcony overlooks the lovely Amanzimtoti sports fields. The bedrooms are light, sunny and spacious. There is a neatly fitted bathroom and a separate toilet. A lock up garage is included with the flat, to house your precious vehicle. The location is superb, as it is in a quiet cul-de-sac close to the highways going North and South and near all schools and shopping malls, and only a five-minute drive to the beach. What more could you want If this sounds interesting to you, please give me a call and I will arrange an appointment to view.
